description: Opt-in automerge for non-breaking minor, patch, pin, and lock file updates. Also merges 0.x updates to pre-commit hooks and GitHub Actions, and prek patches.

packageRules.description: A breaking change, such as a semver 0.x minor, can pass every check and still break behaviour no test covers. Hooks and actions are exempt because they only change CI
A tool needs the same review whether an action's input or another file pins it
A major merges only in a repository that opts in by listing automerge-workflow-majors after this preset
Consumers that pin prek run it in a required check, so a broken 0.x patch fails before merge. Renovate updates every prek pin in one PR, so that check tests all of them
